items.claim: 全年 EPS 指引區間更新為 17.70–17.90 美元
items.quote: The updated full year range is $17.70 to $17.90
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 第三季 EPS 指引區間 4.45–4.55 美元
items.quote: Third quarter guidance range is $4.45 to $4.55
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 指引區間中點假設經濟無改善
items.quote: the range assumes no economic improvement at the midpoint
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 基礎量能回升尚未納入下半年指引，需再觀察數季
items.quote: we'd like a few more quarters under our belt
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: Q2 到 Q3 排除匯率後 EPS 中點增加 0.05 美元
items.quote: increase $0.05 at the midpoint when excluding FX
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 2027 年 EPS 成長以 8%–12% 演算法為基準，不需總經改善；正式指引年底至明年初再給
items.quote: We're not looking for macro.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 管理層指 EPS 演算法為 8% 至 12%
items.quote: we should be delivering 8% to 12%
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 氦氣假設未變動：指引維持不變
items.quote: we left the guidance intact
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 管理層對總經採中立立場，交由投資人自行判斷
items.quote: we have taken a neutral stand
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: Q2 營業利益率 29.5%，年減 60bp（排除成本轉嫁為 30bp）
items.quote: Operating margins of 29.5% decreased 60 basis points
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 表達對本季利益率不滿意
items.quote: we are not satisfied with our margin performance
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說明美國居家醫療（Lincare）拖累美洲利益率，排除後利益率將上升
items.quote: Excluding this, margins would have increased.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: APAC 利益率下滑歸因於電子客戶的低毛利設備銷售
items.quote: APAC erosion is mostly due to lower margin equipment sales
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 管理層預期多項利益率逆風為暫時性
items.quote: we expect many of these margin headwinds to be temporary
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 氦氣定價改善但因調度成本，利潤率層面暫時稀釋；美元貢獻為正
items.quote: that grossing up effect right now is a little bit dilutive
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 估 Lincare 拖累約比分析師估算（Q2 約 3,000 萬）高 30%
items.quote: probably say 30% higher than that number, give or take
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: Lincare 面臨勞動成本通膨與給付環境變化的持續逆風
items.quote: persistent headwinds, right, from labor cost inflation
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: Q2 價格 +2%，與當地通膨大致同步；Lincare 定價不足
items.quote: The price increase of 2% was broad-based
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 回測：2025 年上半年利益率強、下半年弱，全年年比較基期有利
items.quote: I'm fully expecting us to see better year-over-year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 回溯項目的利益率隨產能利用率爬升而改善
items.quote: I always expect backlog projects to continue to improve
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 承諾第三季利益率環比改善
items.quote: I fully expect sequential improvement into the third quarter
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 表示本季將採取成本行動，並於十月電話會議提供更多細節
items.quote: we will likely look to take some cost actions this quarter
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 預告下次（十月）電話會議將說明已採取的行動
items.quote: what we've done in the October call
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 預期年底 sale-of-gas 在手訂單仍維持 8 開頭（億美元級 80 億以上）
items.quote: backlog to finish the year with an 8 handle
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 管理層預期氦氣回收在未來數季反映於利益率
items.quote: I fully expect that it will over the next couple of quarters
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 太空市場於 2030 年前達 10 億美元的目標維持不變
items.quote: we are on track for that $1 billion opportunity
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 管理層表示組織承諾達成股東期待
items.quote: We know our owners expect more
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 年初至今已部署 60 億美元資本
items.quote: Year-to-date, we've deployed $6 billion of capital
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 預期已確保成長性資本支出將持續為重大資金用途
items.quote: we expect this number to remain a significant use of capital
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 營運現金流因工程業務時點偏弱，預期下半年回升
items.quote: we expect the second half to step up like prior years
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CapEx 預期上調，來自新增專案與商業太空基礎 CapEx
items.quote: The CapEx number on the estimate was bumped up.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 投資標準為稅後兩位數無槓桿 IRR
items.quote: post-tax double-digit IRR -- unlevered IRR perspective
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 專案決策依 IRR，不依營收或利益率
items.quote: we make our decisions on IRR
items.speaker: CFO

items.quote: evaluate the strategic fit of this U.S. homecare business
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 已有 Lincare 策略選項評估並行於改善行動
items.quote: evaluating what the strategic options for this business are
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 電子業 Q2 年增 18%，預期動能延續下半年
items.quote: had 18% growth in second quarter
items.speaker: CEO

items.quote: we added $1 billion of new electronics wins to the backlog

items.claim: 航太占製造業成長逾 1/3
items.quote: aerospace accounted for more than 1/3

items.quote: signed up new customers with long-term contracts
items.speaker: CEO

items.quote: revenue has ranged anywhere from 20% to 50%

items.quote: you'll see a blend of sale of gas and some sale of plant

qa_flags.question: Laurent Favre 問美國居家醫療業務目前是否獲利、拖累有多大
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未直接回答是否獲利；改談排除 Lincare 後美洲利益率 +20bp、氣體業務表現良好與硬貨組合

qa_flags.question: Jeff Zekauskas 問是否已決定出售 Lincare、決策時程為何
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未回答是否出售或時程；僅說同步評估策略選項並「with diligence」

qa_flags.question: David Begleiter 追問 2027 年氦氣是否為順風
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未確認順風；僅答氦氣將正常化，並稱需 wait and see，量價組合複雜

qa_flags.question: Duffy Fischer 問荷莫茲海峽解決後一年後的影響
qa_flags.response_pattern: 拒絕推測明年狀況，稱先看海峽問題如何解決
